trailhead.label: The village of Piampaludo (Sassello), the published start

cautions: About 7 km of the walk, out and back, is a mountain path (T2) with stony, uneven ground: wear proper shoes and watch your dog’s paws.
The top of the walk is on the open ridge of the Alta Via dei Monti Liguri: turn back in thunderstorms, strong wind or mist.
The walk crosses the Urbe–Piampaludo road near the start and follows lanes open to cars for about 2 km each way: keep your dog close.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The village of Piampaludo (Sassello), th: Il borgo di Piampaludo (Sassello), la partenza ufficiale
textIt.About 7 km of the walk, out and back, is: Circa 7 km del percorso, tra andata e ritorno, sono un sentiero di montagna (T2) sassoso e irregolare: porta scarpe adatte e fai attenzione alle zampe del cane.
textIt.The top of the walk is on the open ridge: La parte alta del percorso è sul crinale aperto dell’Alta Via dei Monti Liguri: torna indietro in caso di temporale, vento forte o nebbia.
textIt.The walk crosses the Urbe–Piampaludo roa: Il percorso attraversa la strada Urbe–Piampaludo vicino alla partenza e segue stradine aperte alle auto per circa 2 km all’andata e al ritorno: tieni il cane vicino.
